bio.text: Ron Eller is the Republican candidate for Mississippi's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
He is a military veteran from West Virginia who moved to Mississippi after retiring from the military following 20 years of service.
He was the Republican candidate in the district in 2024, losing to Rep. Bennie Thompson 62% to 38%.

sources.title: Meet the Candidates for Mississippi's 2nd U.S. Congressional District in the Nov. 3 Elections
